Linde plc (Linde) is an industrial gas and engineering company. The company primarily operates in the industrial gas industry. Linde's main product lines include atmospheric gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, rare gases, and process gases like carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, electronic gases, specialty gases, and acetylene. The company also designs and constructs equipment for industrial gas production. Linde's products and services cater to a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, chemicals and energy, manufacturing, metals and mining, food and beverage, and electronics. The company also offers gas production and processing services, including olefin plants, natural gas plants, air separation plants, and hydrogen and synthesis gas plants. It operates globally across North America, South America, Asia, Africa, Europe and Australia. Linde is headquartered in Danbury, Connecticut, the US.
